Class Throwables

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.base.Throwables
public final class Throwables extends Object
Creates exceptions from the exception that caused them.

The methods return the exception rather than throw it, so that the caller throws it: the compiler then knows that the code after it is not reached. 

int port;
try {
    port = Integer.parseInt(text);
} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
    throw Throwables.illegalArgument(e, "Not a port: %s", text);
}

A message format follows the syntax of String.format(Locale, String, Object...) and is formatted in Locale.ROOT, so that messages do not depend on the default locale.

Since:
0.1.1
